liangdabiao-ecom-details-image-root.description: Create visual concepts, image-generation prompts, and optional AI-generated images for product hero images, marketing creatives, social posts, ads, ecommerce PDP visuals, and general visual design tasks. Use when the user asks for visual strategy, image prompt writing, product/marketing image direction, or direct text-to-image generation. In Codex environments use the built-in imagegen tool; elsewhere use the bundled script, which prefers the dreamina-canvas CLI (Seedream 5.5) and falls back to the apiz CLI.
